concept: The bar across the top of a page on a strip of glass: the brand at the start, the destinations, actions at the end.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a solid white or brand-coloured header bar with coloured active link (Bootstrap navbar)
default_to_avoid.kind: navbar, top bar, header, app bar
default_to_avoid.why_not: a solid coloured bar owns a hue and hides the scene

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a level-1 strip of glass that blurs the page when it sticks over it

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current page is semibold and underlined, never only a colour

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: every link and action is a 44px target

variants.reason: A keeps the scene under it and reads on scroll. B brings a hue. C loses contrast over content.

bar.why: a level-1 glass strip across the top, the same in every theme and on every scene

sticky.why: sticks to the top while the page scrolls

brand.why: the product name in semibold at the start

nav.why: the destinations, scrolling sideways if they do not fit

link.why: a 44px link, the same in every theme and on every scene

actions.why: actions pushed to the end, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: a link lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current=page.why: the current page is underlined and semibold, the same in every theme and on every scene
